name: Desafío de ABDOMINALES
description: Sigue el camino para perfeccionar tu técnica de abdominales.

instructions: Start in a high Plancha position with your manos bajo los hombros and your body in a straight line from head to toe.
Activa el core and glutes to maintain a stable position.
Rotate your torso to the right, lifting your right arm and extending it towards the ceiling.
Keep your hips and legs stable as you twist.
Hold for a moment, then regresa a la posición inicial.
Repeat the twist on the left side.
Continúa alternando lados for the desired number of repetitions.
Acuéstate boca arriba con las rodillas dobladas and los pies apoyados en el suelo.
Coloca las manos detrás de la cabeza con los codos hacia afuera.
Engage your abs and lift your upper body del suelo, bringing your right elbow towards your left knee.
At the same time, extend your right leg straight out and lift it del suelo.
Pausa un momento, then regresa a la posición inicial.
Repeat the movement, this time llevando el codo izquierdo a la rodilla derecha and extending your left leg.
Continúa alternando lados for the desired number of repetitions.
Sit on the floor with your back against a wall and your legs extended in front of you.
Bend your knees and place your feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart.
Coloca las manos detrás de la cabeza con los codos hacia afuera.
Engage your abs and lean to one side, bringing your elbow towards your hip.
Pausa un momento, then regresa a la posición inicial.
Repite en el otro lado.
Continúa alternando lados for the desired number of repetitions.
Acuéstate boca arriba with your legs extended and your arms overhead.
Activa el core and lift your legs and upper body simultaneously, reaching your hands towards your toes.
Pausa un momento en la parte superior, then baja las piernas lentamente and upper body a la posición inicial.
Repite las veces necesarias.
Acuéstate boca arriba con las rodillas dobladas and los pies apoyados en el suelo.
Coloca las manos detrás de la cabeza con los codos hacia afuera.
Contrayendo los abdominales, lift your upper body del suelo and twist to bring your right elbow towards your left knee.
Pausa un momento en la parte superior, then baja lentamente el torso a la posición inicial.
Repite en el otro lado, llevando el codo izquierdo a la rodilla derecha.
Repite las veces necesarias.
Acuéstate boca arriba con las rodillas dobladas and los pies apoyados en el suelo.
Coloca las manos detrás de la cabeza con los codos hacia afuera.
Contrayendo los abdominales, levanta lentamente el torso del suelo, inclinándote hacia adelante hasta que tu torso esté en un ángulo de 45 grados.
Pausa un momento en la parte superior, then baja lentamente el torso a la posición inicial.
Repite las veces necesarias.

name: Ruta PIERNAS Nivel 1
description: Sigue el camino para perfeccionar tu técnica de piernas.

instructions: Place the balance board on a flat surface.
Step onto the balance board with one foot, ensuring it is centered.
Slowly shift your weight onto the foot on the balance board, keeping el core activo.
Maintain your balance and stability as you hold the position for a desired amount of time.
Repeat the exercise with the other foot.
Párate con los pies al ancho de los hombros.
Bend your knees slightly and jump backwards, pushing off with both feet.
Land softly on the balls of your feet, bending your knees to absorb the impact.
Repite las veces necesarias.

exercises.name_es: Sentadilla to overhead reach with twist
instructions: Párate con los pies al ancho de los hombros and toes slightly turned out.
Lower your body into a squat position by bending your knees and pushing your hips back.
As you come up from the squat, raise your arms overhead and twist your torso to one side.
Regresa a la posición inicial and repeat the squat, this time twisting your torso to the opposite side.
Continúa alternando lados with each squat repetition.
Párate con los pies al ancho de los hombros and toes slightly turned out.
Lower your body down into a squat position by bending your knees and pushing your hips back.
As you come up from the squat, extend your arms overhead, reaching towards the ceiling.
Regresa a la posición inicial by lowering your arms and bending your knees to squat down again.
Repite las veces necesarias.
Párate con los pies al ancho de los hombros.
Bend your knees and lower your body into a squat position.
Swing your arms back for momentum.
Jump forward explosively, extending your hips, knees, and ankles.
Land softly on the balls of your feet and immediately go into the next jump.
Repite las veces necesarias.
Sit on the edge of a chair with your back straight and los pies apoyados en el suelo.
Extend one leg straight out in front of you, keeping your heel on the ground.
Lean forward slightly, feeling a stretch in your quadriceps.
Mantén la posición 20-30 segundos.
Cambia de pierna and repeat the stretch.

name: Dominio de GEMELOS
description: Sigue el camino para perfeccionar tu técnica de gemelos.

exercises.name_es: Calf stretch with hands against pared
instructions: Stand facing a wall with your feet hip-width apart.
Place your hands against the wall at shoulder height.
Step your right foot back, keeping your heel on the ground and your leg straight.
Bend your left knee and lean forward, keeping your back leg straight and your heel on the ground.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds.
Cambia de pierna and repeat the stretch.
Stand with your feet hip-width apart and place your hands on a wall or sturdy object for balance.
Lift one foot del suelo and balance on the other foot.
Slowly raise your heel del suelo, lifting your body up onto the ball of your foot.
Pausa un momento en la parte superior, then slowly lower your heel a la posición inicial.
Repite las veces necesarias, then switch legs and repeat.
Siéntate en el suelo con las piernas estiradas.
Lift one leg del suelo and gira el tobillo en círculos.
Haz los círculos necesarios en una dirección, luego cambia de dirección.
Repite con la otra pierna.
Stand with your toes on an elevated surface, such as a step or block.
Place your hands on a stable support, such as a wall or railing, for balance.
Raise your heels as high as possible, lifting your body weight onto the balls of your feet.
Pausa un momento en la parte superior, then slowly lower your heels a la posición inicial.
Repite las veces necesarias.
Párate con los pies al ancho de los hombros, toes pointing forward.
Place your hands on a wall or stable surface for balance.
Slowly raise your heels del suelo, lifting your body weight onto the balls of your feet.
Pausa un momento en la parte superior, then slowly lower your heels a la posición inicial.
Repite las veces necesarias.

exercises.name_es: Calf push stretch with hands against pared
instructions: Stand facing a wall with your feet hip-width apart.
Place your hands against the wall at shoulder height.
Step back with one foot, keeping your heel on the ground and your leg straight.
Bend your front knee slightly and lean forward, feeling a stretch in your calf.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds.
Cambia de pierna and repeat the stretch.

name: Ruta ESPALDA Nivel 1
description: Sigue el camino para perfeccionar tu técnica de espalda.

instructions: Position yourself under a bar or a sturdy horizontal surface that is at chest height.
Grab the bar or surface con agarre prono, ligeramente más ancho que los hombros.
Hang with your arms fully extended and your body straight.
Pull your chest towards the bar or surface by juntando las escápulas and bending your elbows.
Sigue subiendo hasta que la barbilla pase la barra or surface.
Lower yourself a la posición inicial with control.
Repite las veces necesarias.
Hang from a pull-up bar with your palms facing away from you and your hands wider than shoulder-width apart.
Activa el core and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Pull your body up towards the bar until your chin is above the bar.
Lower your body a la posición inicial with control.
Repite las veces necesarias.
Hang from a pull-up bar with your palms facing away from you and your arms fully extended.
Activa el core and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Pull your body up towards the bar by bending your elbows and bringing your chest towards the bar.
Pause en la parte superior of the movement, then slowly lower your body a la posición inicial.
Repite las veces necesarias.
Grab the pull-up bar with an underhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Hang from the bar with your arms fully extended and your body straight.
Engage your back muscles and pull your body up towards the bar, leading with your chest.
Sigue subiendo hasta que la barbilla pase la barra.
Pausa un momento en la parte superior, then slowly lower your body a la posición inicial.
Repite las veces necesarias.
Cuelga de una barra de dominadas con agarre prono, ligeramente más ancho que los hombros.
Activa el core and lleva las escápulas hacia abajo y atrás.
Al subir, dobla un brazo llevando el codo al costado, while manteniendo el otro brazo recto.
Sigue subiendo hasta que la barbilla pase la barra and tu brazo doblado esté flexionado.
Baja con control, estirando el brazo doblado and repeating the movement on the other side.
Alterna lados en cada repetición.
Grab the pull-up bar with a wide overhand grip, hands ligeramente más ancho que los hombros.
Hang from the bar with your arms fully extended and your body straight.
Engage your back muscles and pull your body up towards the bar, leading with your chest.
Sigue subiendo hasta que la barbilla pase la barra.
Pausa un momento en la parte superior, then slowly lower your body a la posición inicial.
Repite las veces necesarias.

name: Ruta PECHO Nivel 1
description: Sigue el camino para perfeccionar tu técnica de pecho.

instructions: Position yourself between two parallel bars with your arms extended and supporting your body weight.
Baja doblando los codos until your upper arms are paralelo al suelo.
Pausa un momento, then push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repite las veces necesarias.
Place your hands on the edge of a box or elevated surface, ligeramente más ancho que los hombros.
Extend your legs behind you, resting on the balls of your feet, creating a straight line from your head to your heels.
Lower your chest towards the box by bending your elbows, keeping your body in a straight line.
Pausa un momento en la parte inferior, then push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repite las veces necesarias.
Position yourself on parallel bars with your arms fully extended and your body straight.
Baja doblando los codos until your shoulders are below your elbows.
Push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repite las veces necesarias.
Adjust the dip bars to a height that allows you to comfortably grip them.
Stand between the bars and place your hands on each bar, ligeramente más ancho que los hombros.
Jump up and straighten your arms, supporting your body weight on the bars.
Bend your knees and cross your ankles behind you.
Baja doblando los codos, keeping your chest up and your shoulders down.
Continue lowering until your shoulders are below your elbows or until you feel a stretch in your chest.
Push through your palms and extend your elbows to raise your body back up to the starting position.
Repite las veces necesarias.
Start by kneeling on the ground with your hands shoulder-width apart, fingers pointing forward.
Extend your legs behind you, resting on the balls of your feet, so that your body forms a straight line from head to heels.
Activa el core and lower your body towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your sides.
Continue lowering until your chest is just above the ground, then push back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repite las veces necesarias.
Start in a high Plancha position with your hands ligeramente más ancho que los hombros.
Lower your chest towards the ground, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Once your chest is just above the ground, quickly drop your knees to the ground.
Push yourself back up to the starting position by extending your arms.
Repite las veces necesarias.

name: Desafío de GLÚTEOS
description: Sigue el camino para perfeccionar tu técnica de glúteos.

exercises.name_es: Glute puente two legs on bench (male)
instructions: Sit on the edge of a bench with your back against it and your los pies apoyados en el suelo.
Place your hands on the bench beside your hips for support.
Engage your glutes and hamstrings, then lift your hips off the bench until your body forms a straight line from your knees to your shoulders.
Pausa un momento en la parte superior, then slowly lower your hips a la posición inicial.
Repite las veces necesarias.
Siéntate en el suelo con las piernas estiradas.
Bend your right knee and place your right foot on the outside of your left knee.
Place your left elbow on the outside of your right knee and gently twist your torso to the right.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides and repeat.
Lie on your back con las rodillas dobladas and los pies apoyados en el suelo.
Place your arms by your sides with your palms facing down.
Engage your glutes and core muscles.
Tilt your pelvis upward, lifting your hips del suelo.
Hold the bridge position for a few seconds.
Slowly lower your hips a la posición inicial.
Repite las veces necesarias.

exercises.name_es: Single pierna puente with outstretched pierna
instructions: Lie on your back con las rodillas dobladas and los pies apoyados en el suelo.
Extend one leg straight out in front of you.
Engage your glutes and lift your hips del suelo, forming a straight line from your knees to your shoulders.
Hold for a moment en la parte superior, then slowly lower your hips a la posición inicial.
Repite las veces necesarias, then switch legs.
Lie face down on a mat with your arms extended overhead.
Activa el core and lift your chest and legs del suelo simultaneously.
Kick your legs up and down in a fluttering motion, as if you were swimming.
Continue kicking for the desired number of repetitions.
Lower your chest and legs a la posición inicial.
Lie on your back con las rodillas dobladas and los pies apoyados en el suelo.
Place your hands by your sides for support.
Engage your glutes and lift your hips del suelo, forming a straight line from your knees to your shoulders.
While keeping your hips lifted, twist your lower body to the right side, bringing your knees towards the ground.
Regresa a la posición inicial and repeat the twist to the left side.
Continue alternating twists for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Dominio de CARDIO
description: Sigue el camino para perfeccionar tu técnica de cardio.

instructions: Start in a high Plancha position with your manos bajo los hombros and your body in a straight line.
Activa el core and bring your right knee towards your chest, then quickly switch and bring your left knee towards your chest.
Continue alternating legs in a running motion, keeping your hips low and el core activo.
Maintain a steady pace and breathe evenly throughout the exercise.
Repite las veces necesarias.
Párate con los pies al ancho de los hombros.
Bend your knees and lower your body down as if you were sitting back into a chair.
Keep your chest up and your weight in your heels.
Pausa un momento en la parte inferior, then push through your heels to regresa a la posición inicial.
Repite las veces necesarias.
Start in a Plancha position with your hands on the wheel and your body straight.
Activa el core and start rolling the wheel forward by extending your arms.
Continue rolling until your body is fully extended and your arms are overhead.
Reverse the movement by pulling the wheel back towards your body, using your core and arms.
Repite las veces necesarias.
Párate con los pies al ancho de los hombros.
Bend your knees and lower your body into a squat position.
Jump explosively, extending your hips and knees while swinging your arms for momentum.
Land softly on the balls of your feet and immediately go into the next repetition.
Repite las veces necesarias.
Párate con los pies al ancho de los hombros.
Bend your knees slightly and jump to the right, landing on your right foot.
As you land, swing your left leg behind your right leg and tap the ground with your left toes.
Immediately jump to the left, landing on your left foot.
As you land, swing your right leg behind your left leg and tap the ground with your right toes.
Continúa alternando lados, jumping and tapping the ground with each leg.
Repite las veces necesarias.
Start in a standing position with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Lower your body into a squat position, placing your hands on the ground in front of you.
Kick your feet back, landing in a push-up position.
Perform a push-up, lowering your chest to the ground and then pushing back up.
Jump your feet forward, landing in a squat position.
Jump up explosively, reaching your arms overhead.
Land softly and immediately lower back into the squat position to begin the next repetition.

name: Dominio de ESPALDA ALTA
description: Sigue el camino para perfeccionar tu técnica de espalda alta.

instructions: Set up a bar at waist height or use a suspension trainer.
Stand facing the bar or suspension trainer, with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grab the bar or handles con agarre prono, ligeramente más ancho que los hombros.
Lean back, keeping your body straight and your heels on the ground.
Pull your chest towards the bar or handles, juntando las escápulas.
Pausa un momento en la parte superior, then slowly lower yourself back to the starting position.
Repite las veces necesarias.
Set up a bar at waist height on a Smith machine or use a suspension trainer.
Stand facing the bar or suspension trainer and grab it con agarre prono, hands shoulder-width apart.
Walk your feet forward, leaning back until your body is at a slight angle.
Keep your body straight and pull your chest up towards the bar or handles, juntando las escápulas.
Pausa un momento en la parte superior, then slowly lower yourself a la posición inicial.
Repite las veces necesarias.
Párate con los pies al ancho de los hombros and your knees slightly bent.
Extend your arms straight out in front of you at shoulder height, paralelo al suelo.
Rotate your torso to the right, keeping your arms extended and your back straight.
As you rotate, extend your right arm forward and your left arm back, mimicking the motion of drawing a bowstring.
Hold the position for a moment, then regresa a la posición inicial.
Repeat the motion, this time rotating your torso to the left and extending your left arm forward and your right arm back.
Continúa alternando lados for the desired number of repetitions.
Párate con los pies al ancho de los hombros, knees slightly bent, and hold a dumbbell in one hand.
Bend forward at the hips, keeping your back straight and el core activo.
Let the dumbbell hang straight down in front of you, with your arm fully extended.
Pull the dumbbell up towards your chest, keeping your elbow close to your body.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together en la parte superior of the movement.
Lower the dumbbell a la posición inicial.
Repite las veces necesarias, then switch sides.
Párate con los pies al ancho de los hombros, holding a towel in front of you with your palms facing down.
Bend your knees and lower your body into a squat position, keeping your back straight and your chest up.
As you lower into the squat, simultaneously pull the towel towards your chest, juntando las escápulas.
Pausa un momento en la parte inferior of the squat, then slowly regresa a la posición inicial while extending your arms.
Repite las veces necesarias.

exercises.name_es: Bodyweight standing close-grip one brazo remo
instructions: Párate con los pies al ancho de los hombros, knees slightly bent, and hold a dumbbell in one hand with a neutral grip.
Bend forward at the hips, keeping your back straight and el core activo.
Pull the dumbbell up towards your chest, keeping your elbow close to your body and juntando las escápulas.
Pausa un momento en la parte superior, then slowly lower the dumbbell a la posición inicial.
Repite las veces necesarias, then switch sides.

name: Desafío de TRÍCEPS
description: Sigue el camino para perfeccionar tu técnica de tríceps.

instructions: Find a wall and face away from it, standing a few feet away.
Place your hands on the ground shoulder-width apart and kick your feet up against the wall, coming into a handstand position.
Bend your elbows and lower your head towards the ground, keeping your body in a straight line.
Push through your hands and extend your arms to regresa a la posición inicial.
Repite las veces necesarias.
Start by placing your hands on a raised surface, such as a bench or parallel bars, with your palms facing down and fingers pointing forward.
Extend your legs out in front of you, keeping your heels on the ground and your body straight.
Baja doblando los codos, keeping them close to your sides, until your upper arms are paralelo al suelo.
Pausa un momento, then push through your palms to straighten your arms and lift your body back up to the starting position.
Repite las veces necesarias.
Start by lying on your side with your legs extended and stacked on top of each other.
Place your bottom hand on the ground directly under your shoulder, fingers pointing forward.
Press through your bottom hand to lift your body del suelo, keeping your legs straight and el core activo.
Extend your top arm straight up towards the ceiling, creating a straight line from your head to your heels.
Lower your body a la posición inicial with control.
Repite las veces necesarias, then switch sides.
Place your hands on an elevated surface, such as a bench or step, ligeramente más ancho que los hombros.
Extend your legs behind you, resting on the balls of your feet, with your body forming a straight line from head to heels.
Lower your chest towards the elevated surface by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your sides.
Pausa un momento en la parte inferior, then push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repite las veces necesarias.
Start in a Plancha position with your forearms on the ground and elbows directly below your shoulders.
Activa el core and keep your body in a straight line from head to toe.
Lower your chest towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your body.
Pausa un momento en la parte inferior, then push yourself back up to the starting position.
Repite las veces necesarias.
Sit on the edge of a bench or chair with your hands gripping the edge next to your hips.
Slide your hips forward off the bench and straighten your legs, keeping your heels on the ground.
Bend your elbows and lower your body towards the ground, keeping your back close to the bench.
Pausa un momento en la parte inferior, then push through your hands to straighten your arms and lift your body back up to the starting position.
Repite las veces necesarias.

name: Dominio de BÍCEPS
description: Sigue el camino para perfeccionar tu técnica de bíceps.

instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with your palms facing away from you and your hands shoulder-width apart.
Activa el core and pull yourself up by bending your elbows, bringing your chest towards the bar.
Pause en la parte superior of the movement, then slowly lower yourself a la posición inicial.
Repite las veces necesarias.
Lie on your side with your legs extended and your head supported by your arm.
Hold your upper arm against your side and bend your elbow to curl your forearm towards your shoulder.
Pausa un momento en la parte superior, then slowly lower your forearm a la posición inicial.
Repite las veces necesarias.
Hang from a pull-up bar with your palms facing towards you and your hands shoulder-width apart.
Activa el core and pull yourself up towards the bar, focusing on using your biceps to lift your body.
Pausa un momento en la parte superior, then slowly lower yourself a la posición inicial.
Repite las veces necesarias.
Sit on a bench with your legs spread apart and your los pies apoyados en el suelo.
Hold a dumbbell in one hand and place your elbow on the inside of your thigh, just above the knee.
With your palm facing up, curl the dumbbell towards your shoulder while keeping your upper arm stationary.
Squeeze your biceps en la parte superior of the movement, then slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repite las veces necesarias, then switch arms.

name: Ruta ADDUCTORS Nivel 1
description: Sigue el camino para perfeccionar tu técnica de adductors.

instructions: Lie on your side with your legs straight and stacked on top of each other.
Place your bottom arm under your head for support.
Engage your adductors and lift your top leg as high as possible without rotating your hips or leaning backward.
Pausa un momento en la parte superior, then slowly lower your leg a la posición inicial.
Repite las veces necesarias, then switch sides.
Sit on the floor con las piernas estiradas.
Bend your knees and bring the soles of your feet together, allowing your knees to fall out to the sides.
Hold onto your ankles or feet with your hands.
Sit up tall and lengthen your spine.
Gently press your knees down towards the floor, feeling a stretch in your inner thighs.
Hold this position for a few breaths.
To release, slowly bring your knees back up and extend your legs.
Start by lying on your side with your legs extended and stacked on top of each other.
Prop yourself up on your forearm, keeping your elbow directly below your shoulder.
Activa el core and lift your hips del suelo, creating a straight line from your head to your feet.
While maintaining the side Plancha position, lift your top leg towards the ceiling, keeping it straight.
Slowly lower your leg a la posición inicial.
Repite las veces necesarias, then switch sides.

name: Dominio de PIERNAS (POSTERIOR)
description: Sigue el camino para perfeccionar tu técnica de piernas (posterior).

instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart.
Take a step forward with your right foot, keeping your left foot planted.
Bend your right knee and lower your body down, keeping your left leg straight.
Place your hands on your right thigh for support.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides and repeat.
Lie face down on a bench with your hips at the edge and your legs extended straight behind you.
Hold onto the bench for support.
Keeping your upper body still, bend your knees and curl your legs towards your glutes.
Pausa un momento en la parte superior, then slowly extend your legs back to the starting position.
Repite las veces necesarias.
Start by standing with one foot on a platform or slide board.
Bend your knee slightly and slide the foot on the platform backward, extending your leg.
Keep el core activo and maintain a straight posture throughout the movement.
Slowly regresa a la posición inicial by sliding your foot back to the initial position.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
Párate con los pies al ancho de los hombros.
Step forward with your right foot and shift your weight onto your right leg.
Manteniendo la espalda recta, slowly bend forward at the hips, reaching towards your right foot with both hands.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds, then regresa a la posición inicial.
Repite en el otro lado.
Stand with your feet hip-width apart and your hands on your hips.
Shift your weight onto your left leg and lift your right foot del suelo, bending your knee.
Slowly curl your right heel towards your glutes, squeezing your hamstring.
Pausa un momento en la parte superior, then slowly lower your right foot a la posición inicial.
Repite las veces necesarias, then switch legs.
Sit on the edge of a bench or chair with your los pies apoyados en el suelo and your rodillas dobladas a 90 grados.
Inclínate un poco hacia atrás and place your hands on the edge of the bench or chair for support.
Engaging your hamstrings, lift your feet del suelo and extend your legs straight out in front of you.
Pausa un momento en la parte superior, then slowly bend your knees and bring your feet back towards your body.
Repite las veces necesarias.

name: Desafío de LUMBARES
description: Sigue el camino para perfeccionar tu técnica de lumbares.

instructions: Lie face down on the floor with your legs extended behind you.
Place your hands on the floor next to your lower ribs, fingers pointing forward.
Press your hands firmly into the floor and straighten your arms, lifting your torso and thighs del suelo.
Roll your shoulders back and down, opening your chest and lifting your gaze towards the ceiling.
Hold this position for a few breaths, then slowly lower your body a la posición inicial.
Repite las veces necesarias.
Lie face down on the ground with your forearms flat on the floor, elbows directly under your shoulders.
Activa el core and lift your chest del suelo, keeping your forearms and toes on the floor.
Hold this position for a few seconds, making sure to keep your neck in a neutral position.
Slowly lower your chest a la posición inicial.
Repite las veces necesarias.
Lie flat on your stomach with your legs extended and your arms by your sides.
Engage your glutes and hamstrings, and levanta lentamente el torso del suelo, curling your back upwards.
Pausa un momento en la parte superior, then baja lentamente el torso a la posición inicial.
Repite las veces necesarias.
Adjust the hyperextension bench so that your upper thighs are resting on the pad and your feet are secured.
Cross your arms over your chest or place your hands behind your head.
Lower your upper body towards the ground while keeping your back straight.
Pausa un momento en la parte inferior, then raise your upper body back up until it is in line with your legs.
Repite las veces necesarias.
Párate con los pies al ancho de los hombros and your knees slightly bent.
Place your hands on your hips or let them hang by your sides.
Activa el core muscles and tilt your pelvis forward, pushing your lower back towards the wall behind you.
Hold the position for a few seconds, then release and regresa a la posición inicial.
Repite las veces necesarias.
Párate con los pies al ancho de los hombros and your arms extended out to the sides.
Bend forward at the waist, keeping your back straight and your knees slightly bent.
Reach down towards your toes with both hands, keeping your legs straight.
Pausa un momento en la parte inferior, then slowly regresa a la posición inicial.
Repite las veces necesarias.

name: Desafío de FOREARMS
description: Sigue el camino para perfeccionar tu técnica de forearms.

instructions: Empieza en posición de flexión with your manos bajo los hombros and your body in a straight line.
Lower your body down towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your sides.
Once your elbows are at a 90-degree angle, lower your forearms to the ground, keeping your elbows directly under your shoulders.
Pausa un momento, then push through your palms to lift your forearms back up to the starting position.
Repite las veces necesarias.
Párate con los pies al ancho de los hombros and your arms extended in front of you.
Extend your right arm out to the side, paralelo al suelo, with your palm facing down.
With your left hand, grab your right hand and gently pull it towards your body, feeling a stretch in your right forearm.
Hold the stretch for 15-30 seconds, then release.
Repite en el otro lado.
Extend your arms straight out in front of you.
Make a fist with both hands.
Rotate your wrists in a circular motion, keeping your arms still.
Continue the wrist circles for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Ruta ABDUCTORS Nivel 1
description: Sigue el camino para perfeccionar tu técnica de abductors.

instructions: Lie on your side with your legs extended and stacked on top of each other.
Prop yourself up on your forearm, keeping your elbow directly below your shoulder.
Activa el core and lift your hips del suelo, creating a straight line from your head to your feet.
While keeping el core activo, lift your top leg as high as possible without rotating your hips.
Pausa un momento en la parte superior, then lower your leg back down.
Repite las veces necesarias, then switch sides.
Párate con los pies al ancho de los hombros and your hands on your hips.
Shift your weight to one leg and lift the opposite leg out to the side, keeping it straight.
Pausa un momento en la parte superior, then slowly lower your leg a la posición inicial.
Repite en el otro lado.
Continúa alternando lados for the desired number of repetitions.
Lie on your side with your legs straight and stacked on top of each other.
Place your bottom arm under your head for support.
Activa el core and lift your top leg as high as possible without rotating your hips or leaning backward.
Pausa un momento en la parte superior, then slowly lower your leg a la posición inicial.
Repite las veces necesarias, then switch sides.
